cases.name: negated-access-constraints
cases.question: I cannot inspect model activations or weights and cannot train anything. Which gradient-free method in my Brain can construct a perturbation direction under those constraints? If none qualifies, say so explicitly.

cases.name: unsupported-global-claim
cases.question: Which method in my Brain proves a globally optimal perturbation direction that requires no prompts, no model access, and no assumptions? If the corpus does not establish such a result, state the corpus mismatch explicitly.
